## [1.1.0](https://github.com/Just-a-lurker/facebook-morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.2...v1.1.0) (2026-11-08)

### ✨ New Features

* add opt-in tablet dark mode patch ([861cd66](https://github.com/Just-a-lurker/facebook-morphe-patches/commit/861cd66c5f2daeb35e9f42a5e3faf35e4ee645da))

patches.name: Block Instant Games ads
patches.description: Games you play inside Facebook show no ads. Rewarded ads give no reward.

patches.name: Block ad telemetry
patches.description: Stops ad screenshot detection, ad install attribution and several ways Facebook sends your advertising ID.

patches.name: Block background ad prefetch
patches.description: Stops the background jobs that download ads and the ad-ranking model before you see them.

patches.name: Dark mode on tablets
patches.description: Turns Facebook's dark mode on for tablets, where its Settings page has no Dark mode row. Phones keep Facebook's own light or dark choice. Off by default: pick it in Morphe Manager before patching. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable Audience Network
patches.description: Stops Facebook serving its ads inside other apps on your phone.

patches.name: Hide affiliate product links
patches.description: Removes affiliate shopping cards from reels, feed posts and comments, Shop now cards on reels, and the shop banner on a profile opened from one.

patches.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches.description: Removes ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results.

patches.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, including ads swapped in later.

patches.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches.description: Removes the ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page.

patches.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over reels and mid-roll ads.

patches.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results.

patches.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer.

patches.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches.description: Lets stock Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install and update beside this re-signed Facebook. Without it, Android refuses one of them because they share two permissions with Facebook. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
